indications: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Acetaminophen Tablets, USP are indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Acetaminophen Tablets, USP are supplied as follows:
                  5 mg/325 mg
                  White to off-white, capsule shape with H5/325 on one side and R bisect P on the other side.
                  
                     NDC: 71335-1811-1: 30 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                     NDC: 71335-1811-2: 60 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                     NDC: 71335-1811-3: 90 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                     NDC: 71335-1811-4: 8 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                     NDC: 71335-1811-5: 20 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                     NDC: 71335-1811-6: 28 TABLETs in a BOTTLE
                  
                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
                  Dispense in a tight, light-resistant container as defined in the USP with a child-resistant closure.
                  Store Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Acetaminophen Tablets securely and dispose of properly [see PRECAUTIONS, INFORMATION FOR PATIENTS/CAREGIVERS].
